name: marketingskills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the marketingskills capability.

prompts.name: optimize_copywriting
prompts.template: Improve this marketing copy for better conversion and engagement: {copy_draft}
prompts.use_case: Improving website landing page conversion rates

prompts.name: seo_analysis
prompts.template: Analyze the following content and provide SEO keyword recommendations: {marketing_data}
prompts.use_case: Generating high-quality copywriting for email campaigns

prompts.name: conversion_rate_optimization
prompts.template: Given these performance metrics {performance_metrics}, suggest improvements to increase conversion rates.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing web content for search engine rankings

prompts.name: growth_strategy_generation
prompts.template: Generate growth engineering strategies tailored for {target_audience} to enhance marketing reach.
prompts.use_case: Analyzing marketing analytics to identify growth opportunities
